country.description: UberEats country context. Used to set the delivery location for the API request. Choose the country where the restaurants are located.
country.title: Country

maxItemsPerRestaurant.description: Maximum number of menu items to extract per restaurant. Set lower to reduce run time for large menus.
maxItemsPerRestaurant.title: Max Items Per Restaurant

restaurantUrls.description: List of UberEats restaurant page URLs to scrape. Each URL must be a valid https://www.ubereats.com/store/... URL. The store identifier is the last path segment (e.g. P21H_Lf3Se2wSmjGHfoFcQ).
restaurantUrls.title: Restaurant URLs
